description: Given a website domain, returns a compact company card: the business name and its source, a generic role contact address (info@, sales@ ...) only if the site lists one, never a personal address, and up to 10 technology platform names. Same scrape and check as /scrape, without the evidence detail, at half the price. Free prompt-injection scan included. Not charged if the page is unusable or no business name is found. May take up to ~100 s; near that, the public URL can cut a call off (HTTP 524). Costs $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, no scheme or path, e.g. mailchimp.com

name: company_card
title: Company card from a website
